epsSubmission.confirm: I confirm this report is fictional and approve publication of this exact preview.
epsSubmission.alreadyAttempted: This signed version was already accepted or has an unknown outcome. Inspect its history; another submission is blocked. A signed amendment requires a new explicit action.
epsSubmission.configurationChanged: The active EPS configuration changed. Build a new preview with the current mapping.
epsSubmission.validationRequired: Resolve validation findings and run the pinned validator before submission.
epsSubmission.disabled: Activate an EPS configuration in Admin first.
epsSubmission.fictionalOnly: Only explicitly fictional reports may be sent to the public hackathon service.
epsSubmission.commandConflict: This command belongs to another preview. Refresh submission history.
epsSubmission.finding.incompatibleMappin: An outgoing mapping is incompatible with this signed version’s pinned form or clinical semantics. Build a new lineage with a compatible mapping.
epsSubmission.accessDenied: Report access is no longer available. Identifying previews and history were cleared.
review.identifier.explanation: Sign an attributable amendment to the configured patient field. Other missing requirements remain open. Delivery is queued and requires separate confirmation.
review.identifier.attestation: I attest that I have verified this patient identifier and sign this correction.
review.identifier.stale: The report, assignment or mapping changed. Refresh requirements and review your correction.
review.identifier.invalid: The correction could not be accepted. Check the identifier and current requirements.
review.identifier.unavailable: Requirements could not be loaded or the correction could not be confirmed. Retry when connected.
review.identifier.saved: Signed identifier correction saved. Delivery remains pending confirmation.
review.mappingRepair.help: Repair mappings in COS administration, save and test the draft, then activate it. Return here to revalidate this report. This does not change patient documentation.
review.mappingRepair.unavailable: Mapping repair is unavailable. Refresh and try again.
review.mappingRepair.stale: The report or configuration changed. Check active mappings again.
review.mappingRepair.ready: All identifiers are satisfied. Eligible delivery can be queued.
review.mappingRepair.patientConflict: The configured patient field or namespace changed. Verify that the following selection identifies the same patient. Correct an incorrect clinical value using Document valid identifier.
review.mappingRepair.acceptPatient: I verified that this configuration selection identifies the same patient.
review.mappingRepair.recipientConflict: Established recipient or encounter routing changed. Review the activated COS configuration before continuing.
review.mappingRepair.acceptRecipient: I authorize the activated recipient and encounter routing for this unprepared delivery.
review.mappingRepair.unsafe: Prepared, attempted, or uncertain delivery cannot be retargeted. Preserve its history and resolve the outcome first.
review.transmission.requirement.pdfMappi: PDF link identifier mapping is missing.
hospital.cos.retryHelp: After each definite temporary failure, retry after the next delay with up to 10% jitter. Up to five delays, each 1–1440 minutes; leave empty to disable. Defaults: 1, 5, 15, 30, 60 minutes (about 111 minutes total). Existing deliveries keep their original versioned policy.
review.recovery.retryBudget: Automatic retries: {reserved} of {total} reserved; {attempts} receiver attempts. Policy revision {revision}.
review.recovery.retryPaused: Automatic retries paused: COS is inactive or its active configuration differs from this delivery’s pinned configuration.
review.recovery.retryExhausted: Automatic retry budget exhausted. Deliberate Review recovery is required.
hospital.cos.retryEffect: For new deliveries: one initial attempt plus {retries} automatic retries, about {minutes} minutes cumulative delay excluding request duration.
review.reconciliation.saved: Reconciliation recorded. No contact or note was resent.
review.reconciliation.help: Check the receiving simulator for signed amendment {sequence}. A retry requires confirmed non-delivery and a durable fence against late writes. Real COS reconciliation remains blocked until its contract is verified.
review.reconciliation.outcome.not-stored: No note stored; original attempt fenced
cosDelivery.finding.reconciliationUnsupp: The real receiver has no verified reconciliation contract.
cosDelivery.finding.reconciliationUnreso: Stored evidence could not be verified. Resend remains blocked.
cosDelivery.finding.reconciledNotStored: Verified non-delivery: no note was stored and the original attempt is fenced against late writes.
review.reconciliation.retryReady: A deliberate retry can reuse the same prepared clinical content after verified non-delivery. The automatic retry budget is unchanged.
